title: A small coalition forcing a negative bias
statement: Let $n\ge 2$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be monotone, with the signs ordered by $-1<1$. If the uniform mean of $f$ is at most $99/100$, there is a set $J$ of coordinates of size at most $10000n/\log n$ such that forcing every coordinate in $J$ to $-1$ gives a function whose uniform mean is at most $-99/100$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a monotone function from the $n$ dimensional sign cube to $\{-1,1\}$
The mean of $f$ is at most $99/100$
